title: campus-lab site: drop the disclaimer footer; keep name and build stamp
body:

Removes the "What this is, honestly" paragraph and the "Where this page came from" explanation from the page footer. The footer is now just `Timothy Burch · github.com/tburchj` and a one-line stamp: `Built from commit … · design … · build … · 92 checks passed · <timestamp>`.
